Single functional bug: Ask Owen 'stuck fermentation' query does not surface the AWRI Fact Sheet on Stuck & Sluggish Fermentation in sopTitles.

minor.issue: sopTitles returns named-bible citations (Boulton, Jackson, Zoecklein) correctly but does NOT include 'AWRI Fact Sheet — Stuck & Sluggish Fermentation'. Regex /AWRI Fact Sheet — Stuck/ produces no match. AWRI awri_stuck_fermentation label exists in /app/server/routers/tutor.ts (line ~462) so the retrieval / labelmap wiring is not surfacing AWRI chunks for this question. rca of the issue: AWRI Fact Sheet — Stuck & Sluggish Fermentation not appearing in sopTitles: the awri_stuck_fermentation entry is defined in /app/server/routers/tutor.ts SOURCE_LABEL map (~line 462) and the retrieval boost gives awri_ prefix a 0.9 score (line 412), but for the question 'My fermentation is stuck at 8 Brix, what should I check?' with mode=home_winemaker/batchSize=50, sopTitles returned only Boulton (Ch.3), Jackson (Ch.6), Zoecklein (Ch.8) — all fermentation named-bible chapters. The AWRI stuck-ferment chunk is either (a) not ingested into diy_knowledge_chunks with sourceDoc='awri_stuck_fermentation', (b) ranking below top-K threshold, or (c) filtered out by the DIY branch (line ~560). Reproduction: `curl -b cookies -X POST $BASE/api/trpc/tutor.ask -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"json":{"question":"My fermentation is stuck at 8 Brix, what should I check?","mode":"home_winemaker","batchSizeLitres":50}}'` and inspect result.data.json.sopTitles.
